evidence.reference: Binding picture: tenant.tenant.events is INBOUND for ecommerce-catalog-service and ecommerce-image-service (producer ecommerce-tenant-service, store-provisioning); catalog.* topics are OUTBOUND to the query services.

Heartbeats are disabled because with IdentityReplicationPolicy a 'heartbeats' topic would exist on both sides and could be mirrored both ways; explicit escaped topic names keep the two allow-lists disjoint.
